corridorChange.finding: The Folsom-Howard Streetscape Project reconstructs the modelled corridor. Folsom (2nd-11th): SFMTA 2022 fact sheet states a reduction to 2 general-purpose lanes from 3 and 4, with a two-way separated bikeway; project page (update September 2026) reports new traffic signals on Folsom 8th-11th (about 95% complete) and the full Folsom corridor about 75% complete, targeting substantial completion in October 2026. Howard: design complete, construction 2026-2029. SFMTA pages differ on some details (transit-lane extent, per-block lanes): the as-built configuration must be verified, not assumed.
corridorChange.consequence: Every count, timing plan and geometry dated before reconstruction describes a different street. Calibration must target one epoch: either a historical pre-project study with same-epoch timing cards, or new post-construction observations after a stabilisation period fixed in advance. Mixing epochs is a protocol failure.
corridorChange.verification: Project page read directly on 2026-10-23; fact-sheet lane statement taken from an SFMTA-domain search result (PDF not rendered locally). Re-read before sealing the protocol.
